description:
Turn CSV, TSV (spreadsheet paste) or an existing Markdown table into a GitHub Flavored Markdown table. The first row is the header; pipes are escaped as \|, line breaks inside cells become
, and columns can be padded so the pipes line up (CJK-width aware). Returns: Text: the Markdown table. structuredContent { markdown, rows (including header), columns, detected ('csv' | 'tsv' | 'markdown' | 'other'), errors[] }. Example input: {"text":"Item,Qty,Price\nApple,3,$1.20\nKiwi,12,$0.50","align":"none","pretty":true,"outer_pipes":true,"bold_header":false} On error, includes hint: Put the header in the first row. Quote CSV fields that contain commas or line breaks.

align.description: Alignment for every column (none keeps alignment from a Markdown input).

outer_pipes.description: Start and end each row with |.

pretty.description: Pad cells so the columns line up in plain text.

text.description: CSV, TSV or Markdown table text. The delimiter is detected automatically.

name: markdown_table
title: Markdown table from CSV, TSV or Markdown
